title: Generic injectivity of the invariant map (reduction of PGL2 to finite G-bar) asserted, not proved (G7)

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body: Lemma 2.3 / Cor 7.x state the invariant map is 'generically one-to-one' on isomorphism classes, which is needed for $\Spec R$ to be the coordinate ring of the stratum image. This requires that the (positive-dimensional) admissible coordinate-change group $\Gamma\le\mathrm{PGL}_2$ reduces, after normalization, exactly to the finite $\bar G$ — i.e. the normalization removes the continuous part of $\Gamma$. That reduction is asserted but not proved, and it inherits the non-$\bar G$-stable-slice problem of the linearity gap. Without it the identification 'coordinate ring of the stratum image $= k[U]/I$' is unjustified.
